title: Last Light
description: Search the abandoned Blackwood school for three keys before your torch fades. Keep the pursuing shade in your beam, replenish your light and unlock the east exit.
controls: WASD / arrows to move; mouse to aim. Hold the mouse or drag on touch to walk toward the pointer. Enter / Space to start. P / Escape to pause. R to restart.

zh-CN.title: 最后的光
zh-CN.description: 在废弃的黑木学校里，手电熄灭前找到三把钥匙。用光束逼退追来的暗影，补充电量，打开东侧出口。
zh-CN.controls: WASD / 方向键移动，鼠标瞄准手电；按住鼠标或触屏拖动朝指针方向走 · Enter / 空格开始 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
